title: Socii Dispatch 07
content: It’s been a LONG road to 2.0. Old Socii was busted and didn’t feel good to use. Even <em>I</em> didn’t want to use it so changes had to be made. New Socii is super pleasant to use and I’m happy again. What follows is a deep-dive into the history of the architecture and why I made the changes I made.
